name: task dispatcher
normative-structure: A dispatch is worked because this office released it — and a release is derived, never judged: the standing registers are swept for open advisories naming a component the task relies on — an open anomaly, an undisposed idea, a requirement in flight, a change approved and not yet applied — and a clean sweep releases while any hit holds. A held release resolves exactly two ways: the repair of the advisoried component is ordered ahead of the work that relies on it, so the firm's energy pays for the repair first, or an allowance to proceed on the known defect is recorded with its compensation stated — never by nobody having checked. This office simulates nothing and repairs nothing: the wargame belongs to the red army, the fix to the owning lane; this office reads the mail before the walk. Clearance is a readout — byte-identical registers yield the identical release — so a release that cannot be re-derived was not a release, and a defect a register holds but the clearance never consulted was not cleared against.
theory-basis: faa/part-121 dispatch release: a flight departs because a certificated aircraft dispatcher released it, sharing responsibility for the flight with the captain; release follows a review of the NOTAMs — standing advisories that the territory ahead is not as the charts claim — and of the aircraft's open-defect log, never the crew's eagerness to depart

faa/minimum-equipment-list: a known-inoperative item either carries a written allowance to operate with its compensations stated, or the aircraft does not dispatch until it is repaired; the default for an unlisted defect is no-go — repair energy is spent first

iso-iec-ieee-15288 enabling systems: every process establishes the availability of the systems that enable it before execution, and the readiness-review genre (TRR, ORR, FRR) asks whether the apparatus is fit before the act is committed, not whether the product is good
itil/known-error-database: operations consults the register of known errors and the schedule of pending change before acting on the systems they name
osha/lockout-tagout: a tagged machine is not operated, and the tag is checked before the switch — the register of known defects gates the act, not the operator's confidence

huidu-guanli/fa: first wear the shoes — process binds at the point of use rather than being renegotiated by each user; han feizi's craftsman first takes compass and square as his measure (先以规矩为度) instead of trusting his eye
unrealized: the clearance sweep is not mechanized: emsenn/schema/notam, emsenn/schema/mel-item, and emsenn/schema/dispatch-release are seated, but no script yet projects register hits into NOTAM records or emits the CloudEvents release, so clearance is presently an incumbent readout rather than a byte-stable derivation

the release's cross-record rule — every NOTAM on a released disposition deferred by an allowance in force — is stated in the class and owned by the unwritten sweep script, since a schema cannot join across records
a task record does not yet declare its required components, so components-swept is derived by reading the task body rather than read off a field

the clearing duty spec is unseated, so until emsenn/duty/clearing-a-task-against-its-required-components is written the clearance obligation is carried in the deontic profile alone and bears-duty holds only the universal reporting duty
no pools yet seat notam, mel-item, or dispatch-release instances (content/notams, content/mel-items, content/dispatch-releases), so the classes constrain records that do not yet exist

x-provenance.derived-from: user directive of 2026-07-16: an office activated before doing, that checks the existing machinery for anything already in the pipe saying that machinery should be different, and orders that done first — named task-dispatcher per the user's normalization of office names toward real office-sounding names; the public form is the FAA Part 121 dispatch release with NOTAM and MEL review
